flakeRef: path:. (recorded with cwd = the scenario directory under tests/; flake.lock is not created, fixtures have no inputs)

commands.text: cd tests/{scenario} && nix flake show --legacy --all-systems path:. > show.txt 2> /tmp/fsn-record-{scenario}.stderr; echo $?  # app-leaves/show.txt is the independent oracle golden; only ifd-denied records "exits.text"
commands.fsn: cp -R tests/{scenario} <tmp-outside-repo> && cd <tmp-outside-repo> && <repo>/target/debug/fsn [<parts>] > tests/{scenario}/fsn.txt 2> tests/{scenario}/fsn.stderr; echo $?  # fsn.txt is the recorded text golden, frozen once from the real binary; the harness compares everything after the first newline because the root line embeds the temp path

app-leaves.notes: apps.x86_64-linux.withDesc carries meta.description; noDesc has none (show JSON leaf is {"type":"app"}, text 'app: no description'); defaultApp.x86_64-linux is an app leaf with description. fsn must emit description or null. show.txt (raw `nix flake show` text) is the independent end-to-end oracle: the harness compares its ANSI-stripped body to fsn's.

baseline-tree.notes: emptyTop -> show {"type":"unknown"}; empty apps/nixosConfigurations/outputs pruned entirely; legacyPackages.x86_64-linux.nested.set.a is deeper than show's white-list (show emits nested:{}); packages.hello is a derivation; packages.aarch64-linux is an empty set pruned by show. fsn.txt pins the pruned text rendering.

config-leaves.notes: Non-empty config namespaces: nixosConfigurations.host1 aligns with show ("type":"nixos-configuration"); homeConfigurations is an fsn extension namespace show emits as {"type":"unknown"} without recursing. fsn renders both host/user as kind:'config' with configType nixos/home-manager (walker stops at depth 2 for these namespaces); fsn.txt pins the text rendering.

eval-errors.notes: packages.x86_64-linux.broken = throw => nix flake show ABORTS with exit 1 (throw/assert is not caught by show). fsn must exit 0 and mark the leaf kind:'error' while still rendering the sibling derivation; fsn.txt records that text rendering byte-for-byte.

git-dirty-root-line.notes: The fixture is copied to a temp dir which is then made a dirty git worktree (git init; empty commit; `git add -N flake.nix`), so the lockedRef/root line is `git+file://<tmp>` (random path, not recordable). tests/integration.rs captures live `nix flake show --legacy --all-systems` (text) in the same worktree and compares the root line byte-for-byte; the body is compared byte-for-byte against the recorded fsn.txt.

commands.setup: cp -R tests/git-dirty-root-line <tmp> && git init -q && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git add -N flake.nix
commands.fsn: cd <tmp-dirty-worktree> && <repo>/target/debug/fsn > tests/git-dirty-root-line/fsn.txt  # record the body from the same dirty-worktree shape; the root line embeds the temp path and is skipped

ifd-denied.notes: packages.x86_64-linux.ifd is builtins.readFile (derivation ...) i.e. IFD. show exits 0 and emits {} for the leaf; text says 'omitted due to use of import from derivation'. fsn must FAIL by default (IFD disabled) with a non-empty, IFD-mentioning stderr. No static golden is kept (the failure is checked structurally).

non-derivation-leaves.notes: all three leaves (packages/checks/devShells.<sys>.<name> = { name = ...; }) are not derivations: show warns '<attrpath>.name is not a derivation' and omits the leaf. fsn renders the attrset and its string children (extension); fsn.txt pins that text rendering.

template-leaves.notes: templates.noDesc has no description => upstream nix flake show ABORTS with exit 1 (error: attribute 'templates.noDesc.description' does not exist). fsn extends the semantics and renders noDesc with description:null; fsn.txt records that text rendering byte-for-byte.

part-selection.notes: Part selection: `-p packages.x86_64-linux -p packages -p packages.x86_64-linux` reports two swallow notices (the descendant covered by its ancestor, in resolution order) and renders only the packages subtree; apps.x86_64-linux is not rendered. fsn.txt is the recorded stdout (line 1, the root line, embeds the temp path and is skipped; the body is compared byte-for-byte) and fsn.stderr the recorded notice bytes, compared exactly.

part-unknown.notes: Two rows share this fixture. part-unknown-candidates: `-p nope.x`, whose failAt is the flake-outputs attrset, so stderr pins the complete sibling candidate list and its order (`apps, checks, packages`). part-unknown-below-leaf: `-p packages.x86_64-linux.hello.name`, a part strictly below a derivation leaf, so stderr pins the empty-candidates branch (`cannot descend past '...' (not an attrset, or an evaluation-failed leaf)`). Both exit 1 with empty stdout; the full stderr bytes are compared exactly.

walker-namespaces.notes: Real walker label coverage (Gate 1 M6 / Gate 2 F5): devShell/devShells -> development-environment; packages/legacyPackages/defaultPackage/formatter -> package; checks (deep) and hydraJobs keep the plain derivation label (absent). Also covers nixosConfigurations/homeConfigurations/darwinConfigurations config leaves (configType nixos/home-manager/darwin), defaultTemplate/templates, and packages/legacyPackages derivations. fsn.txt pins every label, description and configType in the text rendering.
